## About Muhammad Roman Khan (M R KHAN)
Muhammad Roman Khan is an AI automation builder, software systems architect, and Artificial Intelligence (BS AI) scholar. He specializes in designing practical, resilient AI workflows that replace manual bottlenecks with reliable autonomous operations.
- Academic Foundation: BS in Artificial Intelligence, rigorous background in machine learning, statistics, neural networks, and algorithmic design.
- Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Hands-on implementation of neural networks, decision tree ensembles (XGBoost, Random Forests), and custom PyTorch architectures.
- Data Analytics & Data Engineering: Extraction pipelines, custom Python ETL flows, and normalized SQL/Supabase databases.
- Commercial Track Record: Over 100+ production workflows deployed across n8n, OpenAI API, Supabase, and HubSpot. Generative systems for ArtPoliceJoe generated over $30K in revenue.

## Featured Architecture: Autonomous Enterprise Knowledge Agent & Semantic RAG System
- Case Study Page: https://portfolio.mrkhan.qzz.io/rag/
- Architecture: 3-stage pipeline combining multi-page web scraping (HTTP request triggers), text normalization, recursive semantic chunking, high-dimensional Gemini vector embeddings, Pinecone vector database indexing, and LangChain autonomous reasoning agents with strict anti-hallucination prompt guardrails.
- Key Outcomes: Sub-1.8-second response latency, 100% grounded in verified company truth, 25+ hours saved weekly on repetitive customer and team inquiries.
- Applications: E-Commerce Product Advisory, B2B SaaS Technical Support & Onboarding, Professional Services (Dental/Legal/Real Estate) Lead Intake, and Enterprise Internal SOP/Handbook Retrieval.

## Process (From First Call to Launch)
1. Discovery and audit: Focused conversation to understand operations, bottlenecks, and ROI opportunities.
2. Scope and proposal: Clear deliverables, timeline, and fixed-price or flexible hourly arrangement.
3. Build and launch: Designing, testing under operational volume, and deploying custom systems.
4. Ongoing support: Performance monitoring, workflow maintenance, and system expansion.
